title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027. The new route will put her back in headline rooms across the United States and Canada after she stepped away from touring in 2025.

The route opens in Nashville and ends in California, with stops in New York, Toronto, Chicago and Vancouver along the way. Radio City Music Hall and two nights at Massey Hall are the clearest signs of the jump in scale, giving Young a compact month-long run in larger rooms without turning the announcement itself into a list of 17 dates.

The name Everything Begins plays against Young's "Everything Ends" tattoo and fits the point at which the tour arrives. She returned to the stage this year with two sold-out hometown shows at London's O2 Academy Brixton and festival appearances on both sides of the Atlantic. The new North American dates move that return back into headline rooms on a much larger scale.

That return has also brought new music. "From Down Here" arrived in May after Young went into the studio with James Blake, giving her a new song to carry into this chapter rather than simply extending the cycle around *I'm Only F**king Myself*. Its uneasy pull between missing the old highs and recognizing why they had to end makes it a natural bridge between the record she made before stepping back and the live career she is rebuilding now. "Messy" has remained the song most closely associated with her breakthrough, and its 2026 Grammy win for Best Pop Solo Performance brought another wave of attention. The new tour, however, is designed for her own full-length show and a run of rooms large enough to show how much the audience around her has grown.

[youtube:-u9TRlZADmg]

Presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time through Young's official site. Everything Begins is scheduled to open in Nashville and finish in Los Angeles less than a month later, keeping the announced North American run to 17 shows.

The tour also restores a part of Young's schedule that disappeared when she stepped back in 2025: a sustained series of her own shows across North America. Her return so far has included hometown shows and major festival stages, but Everything Begins gives her a route built around a full set, new music and the larger audience that formed around "Messy." For the first time since that interruption, the next chapter of her live career has a complete North American itinerary attached to it.
